summary: Our project, Left Behind But Remembered, is an educational comic that tells the story of Alex, a student who learns about the Apollo 11 mission and the scientific equipment left on the Moon. Through an engaging visual story, we explain that these instruments were not simply abandoned but were important tools that helped scientists study the Moon and make valuable discoveries. Our project addresses the challenge of making space history and science easier and more interesting for students to understand. It is important because it encourages curiosity, preserves historical knowledge, and reminds us that even old technology can make a meaningful contribution to human progress and future discoveries.
details:
Our project, NEBULA MIND: Left Behind But Remembered, is an educational comic that tells the story of Alex learning about the history of Apollo 11 and the scientific equipment left on the Moon. The project explains how these instruments helped scientists study the Moon and make important discoveries.

The project benefits students by making space history and science easier and more interesting to learn through an engaging visual story. We hope to inspire curiosity about space exploration and help people appreciate the importance of preserving historical knowledge.

Our project is creative because it combines education, storytelling, and visual elements to present scientific information in a fun and easy-to-understand way. In developing the project, our team considered creativity, educational value, clear communication, and making the content suitable and engaging for students.
